text: Refines D-0347 for #613: the shared SVG renderer draws a reader chart from left to right. Each state sits in a column set by its shortest visible-arrow distance from any initial state, so hidden arrows never decide where a state goes, and stable neighbour ordering reduces crossings, leaving none in a forward chain. Each state's box fits its own text. Forward arrows run between adjacent columns, same-column arrows and self-loops take side lanes, back arrows return below the drawing, and every label keeps a reserved space on its own route. The report follows in up to three balanced columns at the same font size, with singular and plural counts. The API, the XML contract, the metadata, accessibility and the 500-state capacity are unchanged, and layout stays outside that contract, so later layout changes don't alter it.
